answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a Groth16 proof over the pasta curves, where a stake S is committed in-circuit and recursively aggregated so a gale of forged registrations cannot outrun verification. Honest agents harbor their stake in a shielded pool, and every new identity must post fresh jade as collateral that the verifier checks. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
